title: diphyes glabra
intro: Diphyes glabra, commonly known as Asian wintergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. This plant is valued for its leaves and roots, which contain bioactive compounds that provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Diphyes glabra include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as acting as an expectorant to help relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include methyl salicylate, which is responsible for its analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects.
